ch.6abbc2bb71588b5b110f34a5 description: Well, looks like Therapist's vaccine actually works, but it ain't much use if there's not enough to go around. So we're keeping the quarantine in place, and personally, I'd tighten the screws even more. Better to stop someone unnecessarily than have to clean up all of Tarkov again. But we've got a more pressing job now. TerraGroup have been watching us this whole time and leaking data through their transmitters. Those are what we need to shut down. Find the equipment and smash the lot to bits. I'm sick of being a lab rat for those c***s. And one more thing: bring me some of Therapist's RDA-78 vaccine. For my lads, and, well, a few others too.

Even my guys are gossiping like a bunch of old ladies in the stairwell. What're they talking about? Some new infection, supposedly, and people going crazy from it. And only in certain areas! Normally, I'd blow it off, but we've had this kind of shit in Tarkov before. Go check the factory, then come back and tell me what you've seen. I'll sort you out when you're back. And if you bump into any of those nutters, put 'em down. Don't need 'em distracting my boys with all this bollocks.

ch.6aba7df2bb9829de330494c7 description: These dodgy rumors ain't just doing the rounds between you and me anymore. Heard even the gangs are joining forces to stop this infection and those lab and factory psychos from getting out? Been a bloody long time since those lot shook hands. Things must be well and truly fucked. Funny thing is, I had a crew head into the lab just before all this kicked off. Went in to have a rummage, see what loot they could get their hands on... They even managed to check in with me, then the line went dead. All I got was a shout that the lights had gone out. After that, I spent another minute listening to noises straight out of a horror flick. Get over there and have a look. Might be someone left alive.

ch.6aba7f65443c3da4df01bb3e description: Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

ch.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 description: Hello. I know Skier has asked you to deliver a batch of vaccine. That's precisely why I'm contacting you now. We still haven't identified the exact strain of the virus, and we don't know whether this preparation has anything to do with it at all. Its origin, storage conditions, and composition have barely been checked. Yet Skier has already decided that's good enough. If you hand the shipment over to him, the drug will immediately be distributed to the public. I'm asking you to do otherwise and bring the batch to me. I need to examine the vaccine before anyone starts using it.

ch.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 successMessageT: I knew you had a good head on your shoulders. It's a shame there are so few people like you.
ch.6abb7e59dcebb0efbc0fda7b description: While Therapist and her clever little lot are still pissing about, checking things and scratching their heads, I've already sorted the problem. Got my hands on a proper vaccine, not some homebrew rubbish. The people who supplied it know their stuff. I've been working with 'em for years. They reckon it was developed during the last outbreak, but it never made it to Tarkov back then. Guess it was waiting for me! Right, enough jawing. Pick up a batch from the treatment facilities at Lighthouse and stash it in the two-storey dorms on Customs. Someone's waiting for it there. And don't you bloody lose that shipment, or I'll wring your neck.

ch.6abb92e1505493a036006ee0 description: Well, fuck me. It's all gone tits up. Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. My suppliers have vanished off the bloody map and left me holding the bag! And who's getting the blame? Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

ch.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

ch.6abf70a8e4732bc101051bf2 description: The situation is getting worse. Security measures across the city are being tightened, but shooting everyone who looks ill won't solve the problem. I need full samples of the mutated virus, and the only way to obtain them is from freshly killed infected. Head to the infected Factory or the Laboratory and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the bodies afterwards and deliver the material for research. If all goes well, I'll give you the first vaccine prototypes. In the current situation, they'll be worth their weight in gold.

ch.6abf712b9b7ad4a865041453: Eliminate infected on Infected Factory or Infected Lab
ch.6abf92bee6a93c846b0fe37d description: Hello. I've been informed that Skier isn't destroying the infected bodies but storing them in refrigerated containers. I have no intention of approaching him directly, but those samples could be a great help in developing a vaccine. Obtain tissue samples from those bodies for me. The more material I have, the more accurately I can study the changes in the virus. I wouldn't recommend going directly to Skier. He certainly won't sell you anything at the moment. Try negotiating with other PMCs or look on the Flea Market. I'm prepared to pay well for this work.

ch.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 description: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.
ch.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 startedMessageT: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. ch.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 successMessageT: The effect was quite different from what I'd expected. There's no point in continuing trials of this serum. I'm discontinuing its development. We'll have to find another way to affect the virus.
ch.6abf94b0e650e8066c5f16cd: Obtain the RDA-68 experimental CS gas grenade
ch.6abf94d799fbd278fbbfff16: Eliminate infected while they are under the effect of the experimental gas grenade
ch.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc description: I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

ch.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 description: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
ch.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 startedMessageT: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
ch.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
ch.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 description: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.
ch.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 startedMessageT: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.
ch.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 successMessageT: The vaccine works, but supplies are too limited, so the quarantine must remain in place for now. We've managed to contain the outbreak, and it's gradually subsiding. Unfortunately, TerraGroup still got what they wanted: data on the new strain and the results of its testing in Tarkov. I hope this was nothing more than scientific curiosity.

cz.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

en.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

en.6abd1078e8a9d48f02fecb36: Survive and extract from Infected Factory or Infected Lab
en.6abf70a8e4732bc101051bf2 description: The situation is getting worse. Security measures across the city are being tightened, but shooting everyone who looks ill won't solve the problem. I need full samples of the mutated virus, and the only way to obtain them is from freshly killed infected. Head to the infected Factory or the Laboratory and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the bodies afterwards and deliver the material for research. If all goes well, I'll give you the first vaccine prototypes. In the current situation, they'll be worth their weight in gold.

en.6abf712b9b7ad4a865041453: Eliminate infected on Infected Factory or Infected Lab
en.6abf92bee6a93c846b0fe37d description: Hello. I've been informed that Skier isn't destroying the infected bodies but storing them in refrigerated containers. I have no intention of approaching him directly, but those samples could be a great help in developing a vaccine. Obtain tissue samples from those bodies for me. The more material I have, the more accurately I can study the changes in the virus. I wouldn't recommend going directly to Skier. He certainly won't sell you anything at the moment. Try negotiating with other PMCs or look on the Flea Market. I'm prepared to pay well for this work.

en.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 description: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.

en.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 successMessageT: The effect was quite different from what I'd expected. There's no point in continuing trials of this serum. I'm discontinuing its development. We'll have to find another way to affect the virus.
en.6abf94b0e650e8066c5f16cd: Obtain the RDA-68 experimental CS gas grenade
en.6abf94d799fbd278fbbfff16: Eliminate infected while they are under the effect of the experimental gas grenade
en.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc description: I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

en.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 description: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
en.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 startedMessageT: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
en.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
en.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 description: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.

en.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 successMessageT: The vaccine works, but supplies are too limited, so the quarantine must remain in place for now. We've managed to contain the outbreak, and it's gradually subsiding. Unfortunately, TerraGroup still got what they wanted: data on the new strain and the results of its testing in Tarkov. I hope this was nothing more than scientific curiosity.

es.6abbc2bb71588b5b110f34a5 description: Well, looks like Therapist's vaccine actually works, but it ain't much use if there's not enough to go around. So we're keeping the quarantine in place, and personally, I'd tighten the screws even more. Better to stop someone unnecessarily than have to clean up all of Tarkov again. But we've got a more pressing job now. TerraGroup have been watching us this whole time and leaking data through their transmitters. Those are what we need to shut down. Find the equipment and smash the lot to bits. I'm sick of being a lab rat for those c***s. And one more thing: bring me some of Therapist's RDA-78 vaccine. For my lads, and, well, a few others too.

es.6aba7f65443c3da4df01bb3e description: Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

Normally, I'd blow it off, but we've had this kind of shit in Tarkov before. Go check the factory, then come back and tell me what you've seen. I'll sort you out when you're back. And if you bump into any of those nutters, put 'em down. Don't need 'em distracting my boys with all this bollocks.
ge.6aba40a15ef26da1360746b8 successMessageT: You run into any nutters? They come charging at you and all? Fuck me, what a bloody mess... Right, we'll have to think this through.
ge.6aba7df2bb9829de330494c7 description: These dodgy rumors ain't just doing the rounds between you and me anymore. Heard even the gangs are joining forces to stop this infection and those lab and factory psychos from getting out? Been a bloody long time since those lot shook hands. Things must be well and truly fucked. Funny thing is, I had a crew head into the lab just before all this kicked off. Went in to have a rummage, see what loot they could get their hands on... They even managed to check in with me, then the line went dead. All I got was a shout that the lights had gone out. After that, I spent another minute listening to noises straight out of a horror flick. Get over there and have a look. Might be someone left alive.

ge.6adb3c0a72be7467c114a0c5: Obtain the special item to use the exfil
ge.6aba7f65443c3da4df01bb3e description: Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

ge.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 description: Hello. I know Skier has asked you to deliver a batch of vaccine. That's precisely why I'm contacting you now. We still haven't identified the exact strain of the virus, and we don't know whether this preparation has anything to do with it at all. Its origin, storage conditions, and composition have barely been checked. Yet Skier has already decided that's good enough. If you hand the shipment over to him, the drug will immediately be distributed to the public. I'm asking you to do otherwise and bring the batch to me. I need to examine the vaccine before anyone starts using it.

ge.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 successMessageT: I knew you had a good head on your shoulders. It's a shame there are so few people like you.
ge.6abb7e59dcebb0efbc0fda7b description: While Therapist and her clever little lot are still pissing about, checking things and scratching their heads, I've already sorted the problem. Got my hands on a proper vaccine, not some homebrew rubbish. The people who supplied it know their stuff. I've been working with 'em for years. They reckon it was developed during the last outbreak, but it never made it to Tarkov back then. Guess it was waiting for me! Right, enough jawing. Pick up a batch from the treatment facilities at Lighthouse and stash it in the two-storey dorms on Customs. Someone's waiting for it there. And don't you bloody lose that shipment, or I'll wring your neck.

ge.6abb7e59dcebb0efbc0fda81: Locate and obtain the vaccine shipment at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

ge.6abb92e1505493a036006ee0 description: Well, fuck me. It's all gone tits up. Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. My suppliers have vanished off the bloody map and left me holding the bag! And who's getting the blame? Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

ge.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

ge.6abf70a8e4732bc101051bf2 description: The situation is getting worse. Security measures across the city are being tightened, but shooting everyone who looks ill won't solve the problem. I need full samples of the mutated virus, and the only way to obtain them is from freshly killed infected. Head to the infected Factory or the Laboratory and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the bodies afterwards and deliver the material for research. If all goes well, I'll give you the first vaccine prototypes. In the current situation, they'll be worth their weight in gold.

ge.6abf712b9b7ad4a865041453: Eliminate infected on Infected Factory or Infected Lab
ge.6abf92bee6a93c846b0fe37d description: Hello. I've been informed that Skier isn't destroying the infected bodies but storing them in refrigerated containers. I have no intention of approaching him directly, but those samples could be a great help in developing a vaccine. Obtain tissue samples from those bodies for me. The more material I have, the more accurately I can study the changes in the virus. I wouldn't recommend going directly to Skier. He certainly won't sell you anything at the moment. Try negotiating with other PMCs or look on the Flea Market. I'm prepared to pay well for this work.

ge.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 description: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.
ge.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 startedMessageT: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. ge.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 successMessageT: The effect was quite different from what I'd expected. There's no point in continuing trials of this serum. I'm discontinuing its development. We'll have to find another way to affect the virus.
ge.6abf94b0e650e8066c5f16cd: Obtain the RDA-68 experimental CS gas grenade
ge.6abf94d799fbd278fbbfff16: Eliminate infected while they are under the effect of the experimental gas grenade
ge.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc description: I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

ge.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc successMessageT: Thank you for your help. I hope we can finally get to the bottom of what's happening in Tarkov.

ge.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 description: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
ge.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 startedMessageT: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
ge.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
ge.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 description: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.
ge.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 startedMessageT: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. ge.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 successMessageT: The vaccine works, but supplies are too limited, so the quarantine must remain in place for now. We've managed to contain the outbreak, and it's gradually subsiding. Unfortunately, TerraGroup still got what they wanted: data on the new strain and the results of its testing in Tarkov. I hope this was nothing more than scientific curiosity.

hu.6abbc2bb71588b5b110f34a5 description: Well, looks like Therapist's vaccine actually works, but it ain't much use if there's not enough to go around. So we're keeping the quarantine in place, and personally, I'd tighten the screws even more. Better to stop someone unnecessarily than have to clean up all of Tarkov again. But we've got a more pressing job now. TerraGroup have been watching us this whole time and leaking data through their transmitters. Those are what we need to shut down. Find the equipment and smash the lot to bits. I'm sick of being a lab rat for those c***s. And one more thing: bring me some of Therapist's RDA-78 vaccine. For my lads, and, well, a few others too.

I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

kr.6aba40a15ef26da1360746b8 description: Alright mate? Got a job for you. Some fucked-up rumors are spreading all over Tarkov... Even my guys are gossiping like a bunch of old ladies in the stairwell. What're they talking about? Some new infection, supposedly, and people going crazy from it. And only in certain areas! Normally, I'd blow it off, but we've had this kind of shit in Tarkov before. Go check the factory, then come back and tell me what you've seen. I'll sort you out when you're back. And if you bump into any of those nutters, put 'em down. Don't need 'em distracting my boys with all this bollocks.

kr.6aba7df2bb9829de330494c7 description: These dodgy rumors ain't just doing the rounds between you and me anymore. Heard even the gangs are joining forces to stop this infection and those lab and factory psychos from getting out? Been a bloody long time since those lot shook hands. Things must be well and truly fucked. Funny thing is, I had a crew head into the lab just before all this kicked off. Went in to have a rummage, see what loot they could get their hands on... They even managed to check in with me, then the line went dead. All I got was a shout that the lights had gone out. After that, I spent another minute listening to noises straight out of a horror flick. Get over there and have a look. Might be someone left alive.

kr.6aba7f65443c3da4df01bb3e description: Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

kr.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 description: Hello. I know Skier has asked you to deliver a batch of vaccine. That's precisely why I'm contacting you now. We still haven't identified the exact strain of the virus, and we don't know whether this preparation has anything to do with it at all. Its origin, storage conditions, and composition have barely been checked. Yet Skier has already decided that's good enough. If you hand the shipment over to him, the drug will immediately be distributed to the public. I'm asking you to do otherwise and bring the batch to me. I need to examine the vaccine before anyone starts using it.

kr.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 successMessageT: I knew you had a good head on your shoulders. It's a shame there are so few people like you.
kr.6abb7e59dcebb0efbc0fda7b description: While Therapist and her clever little lot are still pissing about, checking things and scratching their heads, I've already sorted the problem. Got my hands on a proper vaccine, not some homebrew rubbish. The people who supplied it know their stuff. I've been working with 'em for years. They reckon it was developed during the last outbreak, but it never made it to Tarkov back then. Guess it was waiting for me! Right, enough jawing. Pick up a batch from the treatment facilities at Lighthouse and stash it in the two-storey dorms on Customs. Someone's waiting for it there. And don't you bloody lose that shipment, or I'll wring your neck.

kr.6abb7e59dcebb0efbc0fda81: Locate and obtain the vaccine shipment at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

kr.6abb92e1505493a036006ee0 description: Well, fuck me. It's all gone tits up. Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. My suppliers have vanished off the bloody map and left me holding the bag! And who's getting the blame? Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

kr.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

kr.6abf70a8e4732bc101051bf2 description: The situation is getting worse. Security measures across the city are being tightened, but shooting everyone who looks ill won't solve the problem. I need full samples of the mutated virus, and the only way to obtain them is from freshly killed infected. Head to the infected Factory or the Laboratory and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the bodies afterwards and deliver the material for research. If all goes well, I'll give you the first vaccine prototypes. In the current situation, they'll be worth their weight in gold.

kr.6abf712b9b7ad4a865041453: Eliminate infected on Infected Factory or Infected Lab
kr.6abf92bee6a93c846b0fe37d description: Hello. I've been informed that Skier isn't destroying the infected bodies but storing them in refrigerated containers. I have no intention of approaching him directly, but those samples could be a great help in developing a vaccine. Obtain tissue samples from those bodies for me. The more material I have, the more accurately I can study the changes in the virus. I wouldn't recommend going directly to Skier. He certainly won't sell you anything at the moment. Try negotiating with other PMCs or look on the Flea Market. I'm prepared to pay well for this work.

kr.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 description: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.
kr.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 startedMessageT: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.
kr.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 successMessageT: The effect was quite different from what I'd expected. There's no point in continuing trials of this serum. I'm discontinuing its development. We'll have to find another way to affect the virus.
kr.6abf94b0e650e8066c5f16cd: Obtain the RDA-68 experimental CS gas grenade
kr.6abf94d799fbd278fbbfff16: Eliminate infected while they are under the effect of the experimental gas grenade
kr.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc description: I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

kr.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc successMessageT: Thank you for your help. I hope we can finally get to the bottom of what's happening in Tarkov.
kr.6abfb4e5483926c9d495565a: Hand over the infection data to Skier
kr.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 description: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
kr.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 startedMessageT: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.
kr.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
kr.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 description: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.
kr.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 startedMessageT: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.
kr.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 successMessageT: The vaccine works, but supplies are too limited, so the quarantine must remain in place for now. We've managed to contain the outbreak, and it's gradually subsiding. Unfortunately, TerraGroup still got what they wanted: data on the new strain and the results of its testing in Tarkov. I hope this was nothing more than scientific curiosity.

pl.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 name: Halloween: For the Greater Good - An Agreement
pl.6abbc2bb71588b5b110f34a5 description: Well, looks like Therapist's vaccine actually works, but it ain't much use if there's not enough to go around. So we're keeping the quarantine in place, and personally, I'd tighten the screws even more. Better to stop someone unnecessarily than have to clean up all of Tarkov again. But we've got a more pressing job now. TerraGroup have been watching us this whole time and leaking data through their transmitters. Those are what we need to shut down. Find the equipment and smash the lot to bits. I'm sick of being a lab rat for those c***s. And one more thing: bring me some of Therapist's RDA-78 vaccine. For my lads, and, well, a few others too.

But TerraGroup have already got what they wanted: tested a new strain, watched how we reacted, recorded the lot and walked off with the data. Fuckers played us all along.

pl.6abb92e1505493a036006ee0 description: Well, fuck me. It's all gone tits up. Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. My suppliers have vanished off the bloody map and left me holding the bag! And who's getting the blame? Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

pl.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

pl.6abd1078e8a9d48f02fecb36: Survive and extract from Infected Factory or Infected Lab
pl.6abf70a8e4732bc101051bf2 description: The situation is getting worse. Security measures across the city are being tightened, but shooting everyone who looks ill won't solve the problem. I need full samples of the mutated virus, and the only way to obtain them is from freshly killed infected. Head to the infected Factory or the Laboratory and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the bodies afterwards and deliver the material for research. If all goes well, I'll give you the first vaccine prototypes. In the current situation, they'll be worth their weight in gold.

pl.6abf712b9b7ad4a865041453: Eliminate infected on Infected Factory or Infected Lab
pl.6abf92bee6a93c846b0fe37d description: Hello. I've been informed that Skier isn't destroying the infected bodies but storing them in refrigerated containers. I have no intention of approaching him directly, but those samples could be a great help in developing a vaccine. Obtain tissue samples from those bodies for me. The more material I have, the more accurately I can study the changes in the virus. I wouldn't recommend going directly to Skier. He certainly won't sell you anything at the moment. Try negotiating with other PMCs or look on the Flea Market. I'm prepared to pay well for this work.

pl.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 description: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.

pl.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 successMessageT: The effect was quite different from what I'd expected. There's no point in continuing trials of this serum. I'm discontinuing its development. We'll have to find another way to affect the virus.
pl.6abf94b0e650e8066c5f16cd: Obtain the RDA-68 experimental CS gas grenade
pl.6abf94d799fbd278fbbfff16: Eliminate infected while they are under the effect of the experimental gas grenade
pl.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc description: I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

pl.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
pl.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 description: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.

pl.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 successMessageT: The vaccine works, but supplies are too limited, so the quarantine must remain in place for now. We've managed to contain the outbreak, and it's gradually subsiding. Unfortunately, TerraGroup still got what they wanted: data on the new strain and the results of its testing in Tarkov. I hope this was nothing more than scientific curiosity.

po.6aba7f65443c3da4df01bb3e description: Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

ro.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 description: Heard the old c***'s finally decided to get in touch. Wants to pass along her data on this infection. Well, that's something, at least. Bring me everything she's given you. We'll see what she's dug up and whether any of it's actually worth a damn.

ro.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
ro.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 description: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. We'll test it the same way as the previous preparation, using gas grenades. The procedure for obtaining an experimental sample remains unchanged. Once you have one, use it on the infected and eliminate those affected by the gas. I still need fresh virus samples as well. Work in the infected areas and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the necessary material afterwards.
ro.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 startedMessageT: The data I received from Skier has helped me prepare a new version of the vaccine. ro.6abfb582eac8c75de80bd930 successMessageT: The vaccine works, but supplies are too limited, so the quarantine must remain in place for now. We've managed to contain the outbreak, and it's gradually subsiding. Unfortunately, TerraGroup still got what they wanted: data on the new strain and the results of its testing in Tarkov. I hope this was nothing more than scientific curiosity.

ru.6abbc2bb71588b5b110f34a5 description: Well, looks like Therapist's vaccine actually works, but it ain't much use if there's not enough to go around. So we're keeping the quarantine in place, and personally, I'd tighten the screws even more. Better to stop someone unnecessarily than have to clean up all of Tarkov again. But we've got a more pressing job now. TerraGroup have been watching us this whole time and leaking data through their transmitters. Those are what we need to shut down. Find the equipment and smash the lot to bits. I'm sick of being a lab rat for those c***s. And one more thing: bring me some of Therapist's RDA-78 vaccine. For my lads, and, well, a few others too.

ru.6aba40a15ef26da1360746b8 description: Alright mate? Got a job for you. Some fucked-up rumors are spreading all over Tarkov... Even my guys are gossiping like a bunch of old ladies in the stairwell. What're they talking about? Some new infection, supposedly, and people going crazy from it. And only in certain areas! Normally, I'd blow it off, but we've had this kind of shit in Tarkov before. Go check the factory, then come back and tell me what you've seen. I'll sort you out when you're back. And if you bump into any of those nutters, put 'em down. Don't need 'em distracting my boys with all this bollocks.

ru.6aba7df2bb9829de330494c7 description: These dodgy rumors ain't just doing the rounds between you and me anymore. Heard even the gangs are joining forces to stop this infection and those lab and factory psychos from getting out? Been a bloody long time since those lot shook hands. Things must be well and truly fucked. Funny thing is, I had a crew head into the lab just before all this kicked off. Went in to have a rummage, see what loot they could get their hands on... They even managed to check in with me, then the line went dead. All I got was a shout that the lights had gone out. After that, I spent another minute listening to noises straight out of a horror flick. Get over there and have a look. Might be someone left alive.

ru.6aba7f65443c3da4df01bb3e description: Good afternoon. It seems Tarkov still won't give us a moment's peace... Yes, I am aware of the infection. Something similar happened not so long ago. Back then, we managed to stop the disease from spreading, with my help among other things. It seems I'll have to get involved again, fortunately, we already know where to start. First, we need to establish whether this is the same pathogen. Bring me a blood sample. Bear in mind, I don't need a specimen you've killed yourself. It must be someone who died from the virus on their own. That is the only way I can be sure the virus had enough time to develop inside them. We absolutely cannot afford to waste time on careless mistakes right now. Head to the infected areas and look for lab personnel in protective suits. I suspect they were the first to bear the brunt of the outbreak.

ru.6abb7e434f0ef29f16066d77 description: Hello. I know Skier has asked you to deliver a batch of vaccine. That's precisely why I'm contacting you now. We still haven't identified the exact strain of the virus, and we don't know whether this preparation has anything to do with it at all. Its origin, storage conditions, and composition have barely been checked. Yet Skier has already decided that's good enough. If you hand the shipment over to him, the drug will immediately be distributed to the public. I'm asking you to do otherwise and bring the batch to me. I need to examine the vaccine before anyone starts using it.

ru.6abb7e59dcebb0efbc0fda7b description: While Therapist and her clever little lot are still pissing about, checking things and scratching their heads, I've already sorted the problem. Got my hands on a proper vaccine, not some homebrew rubbish. The people who supplied it know their stuff. I've been working with 'em for years. They reckon it was developed during the last outbreak, but it never made it to Tarkov back then. Guess it was waiting for me! Right, enough jawing. Pick up a batch from the treatment facilities at Lighthouse and stash it in the two-storey dorms on Customs. Someone's waiting for it there. And don't you bloody lose that shipment, or I'll wring your neck.

ru.6abb92e1505493a036006ee0 description: Well, fuck me. It's all gone tits up. Since that vaccine went out, people have been dropping like flies even faster. The infected turn feral in no time, and they take one hell of a lot to put down. My suppliers have vanished off the bloody map and left me holding the bag! And who's getting the blame? Yours fucking truly. That old cow Therapist has already blabbed to half of Tarkov about who got the vaccine and handed it out. So now we've got to clean up this shit ourselves, especially since you're in it up to your neck as well. It's not like I was the one who brought the vaccine here! We put down the infected and keep the clean areas under quarantine. And make your mind up whose side you're on. If you go helping Therapist, don't come crawling back to me. I don't keep rats around. Here's what I need from you now: round up whatever medical supplies you can find. I'll hand them out to my lads in case things go sideways.

ru.6abd0ff5d383d797d602d6c4 description: Hello. I've received the results of the analysis of Skier's chemical. Yes, the very same one you helped him distribute all over Tarkov. I had to buy it back at extortionate prices through intermediaries. You owe me for that, young man. Back to the matter at hand: it isn't a vaccine. Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. As a result, the disease now progresses faster, the infected are more aggressive, and our previous methods of suppression are becoming less effective. If you decide to stay with me, you'll need to work directly in the infected areas. I need people who can enter both the infected Factory and Laboratory, assess the situation and make it back out alive. First, we'll establish exactly what we're dealing with. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

ru.6abf70a8e4732bc101051bf2 description: The situation is getting worse. Security measures across the city are being tightened, but shooting everyone who looks ill won't solve the problem. I need full samples of the mutated virus, and the only way to obtain them is from freshly killed infected. Head to the infected Factory or the Laboratory and eliminate as many carriers as possible. My people will collect the bodies afterwards and deliver the material for research. If all goes well, I'll give you the first vaccine prototypes. In the current situation, they'll be worth their weight in gold.

ru.6abf712b9b7ad4a865041453: Eliminate infected on Infected Factory or Infected Lab
ru.6abf92bee6a93c846b0fe37d description: Hello. I've been informed that Skier isn't destroying the infected bodies but storing them in refrigerated containers. I have no intention of approaching him directly, but those samples could be a great help in developing a vaccine. Obtain tissue samples from those bodies for me. The more material I have, the more accurately I can study the changes in the virus. I wouldn't recommend going directly to Skier. He certainly won't sell you anything at the moment. Try negotiating with other PMCs or look on the Flea Market. I'm prepared to pay well for this work.

ru.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 description: The vaccine prototype works, but it only slows the progression of the infection. I've prepared an antibody serum and want to test it directly on the infected. Administering the drug by hand is too dangerous, so we'll try dispersing it as a gas. For that, we need gas grenades, and there are very few left in Tarkov. If you find any, bring them to me. If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.

ru.6abf93f0e6a93c846b0fe382 successMessageT: The effect was quite different from what I'd expected. There's no point in continuing trials of this serum. I'm discontinuing its development. We'll have to find another way to affect the virus.

Its composition was designed to accelerate the mutation of an existing strain. Only then can we look for a way to stop it.

If not, valuable items will do. Anyone who still has grenades is bound to be interested in a trade. In return, you'll receive an experimental sample. Use it on the infected and check the results.

vi.6abfae3485f9ebf648025acc description: I've compared the data we've obtained with the records from the previous outbreak. There are too many similarities to be coincidental. The strain has changed, as has the infected's response to our treatments, but the overall pattern is almost identical. Skier is still sticking to his story, claiming he was set up. I'm not prepared to take his word for it. However, he now claims to have important information. I'm willing to examine it and share some of my own findings on the infection with him. Perhaps by comparing our information, we'll finally understand what they're testing here and how to fight it. Deliver my findings to Skier.

vi.6abfafda95e39cdaad0bda27 successMessageT: All right, this data's decent. I'll tell my lads to leave Therapist's teams alone from now on. If it comes to it, we'll even cover her people. We can't sort this whole fucking mess out by clearing out the infected alone. We need a vaccine, and there won't be enough to go around. So, for now, it's better for us to stick together with Therapist.
